# The optional fields a business object may carry and usually does not: a
# customer's full address and email, an invoice's billing id and notes, and a
# payment's cheque number. Each is written only when it is there, so a book
# without them never exercises the line that writes them.
customer "C-FULL"
	name: "Full Details Co"
	currency: CAD
	addr1: "Suite 400"
	addr2: "1 Example Street"
	addr3: "Toronto ON"
	addr4: "M5V 1A1"
	email: "ap@example.test"

# A second customer carrying none of them, which is what shows the writer's
# false side. A vendor proves nothing here: the vendor block has no address
# fields at all, so their absence there is true by construction.
customer "C-BARE"
	name: "Bare Co"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-FULL"
	name: "Full Details Supply"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-FULL-001"
	customer_id: "C-FULL"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	billing_id: "PO-99871"
	notes: "Quoted 2026-02-20, net 30"
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 2
		price: 150
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-02
		due: 2026-04-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-FULL-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-03-10
		amount: 300
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Cheque"
		num: "1042"
